_doc: Manual fix-ups applied during pin computation. See tools/project.py for how each section is consumed. Source-of-truth (committed); generated by hand, not by tooling.

synthetic_chars._doc: AP kill-locations whose creature UUID is exposed by the apworld but whose creature is NOT in bg3_npc_data.json (typically quest-spawned creatures that never appear as world-placed templates Larian indexes). Injected into the cache at load time so the rest of the projection pipeline treats them like any other pin. Each entry MUST supply level + world position because we can't recover those from the absent cache row. building follows the patch-tag convention: empty string is exterior.

region_world_offsets._doc: Per-region world-coord translation applied to char positions before bbox computation + projection. Use when kill chars are systematically offset from their actual gameplay positions (relative arrangement correct, just translated). Values are [dx, dz].

grove._why: Druid Grove patrol chars sit ~488 west / ~306 south of the grove gate where they actually fight. Moves centroid from ~(-280, 117) to ~(208, 423) -- inside the wilderness patch at the grove gate.

overworld_centroid_filters._doc: When computing an overview centroid for a multi-zone region, restrict to chars matching this filter so the pin lands at the primary (entry) zone, not the averaged centroid of all zones (which would fall between them). buildings: null matches empty/exterior; world_bbox: [x0, z0, x1, z1] restricts to a region of the level.

grymforge._why: Forge Approach exterior, NOT Selunite Ruins inland.

last_light._why: Anchor at the inn building itself. Region also owns the Meenlock cave (z~-700) and 39 inn-defense waves (z~210); restricting to LastLightInn keeps centroid on the inn proper.

moonrise._why: Tower courtyard, NOT the SE Dungeon outlier.

west_act2._why: Reithwin Town, NOT the basement or HoH Morgue.

overworld_pin_overrides._doc: Per-overworld region-pin canvas-coord overrides. Use when the computed centroid doesn't make narrative sense -- typically for off-overview regions where the player enters via a specific landmark we want the pin to sit next to. Values are [canvas_x, canvas_y] in the overworld's canvas-pixel space. Hand-edited based on the rendered images/maps/<overworld>.png.

grove._why: Druid Grove is at the western edge of WLD_Main_A major-patch bbox; auto-projected centroid clamps to edge. Hand-positioned on visible landmark.

crypt._why: Dank Crypt: same edge-clamp problem as grove.

mindflayer._why: Mindflayer Colony entrance: west side of Moonrise Towers (basement tunnel leading down).

shar_gauntlet._why: Gauntlet of Shar entrance: top of western island area, just west of Last Light Inn.

west_act2._why: Reithwin Town: auto-centroid skewed by LL Defense wave chars at z~210; hand-positioned at actual town centroid on cropped canvas.
